questions: Tell me about an important decision you have made in your life.
How has this decision influenced you since then?
What factors have the biggest impact on the decisions people make?
Describe a subject at school or university that you enjoyed.
Why do you think you enjoyed studying it more than others?
How important is education for a country's development?
Tell me about a piece of technology you use every day.
How would your daily routine change without this technology?
Do you think technology brings people closer together or pushes them apart?
Describe something you have done to help the environment.
How has people's awareness of the environment changed recently?
Whose responsibility is it to solve environmental problems — individuals, companies, or governments?
Tell me about a place you visited that left a strong impression on you.
How did visiting this place change the way you see things?
Why is travelling important for understanding other cultures?
Describe a job or career you find interesting.
What skills would someone need to succeed in this kind of work?
How is the world of work likely to change in the next twenty years?
Tell me about a family member who has had an influence on you.
How have they shaped your character or interests?
How are family relationships changing in modern society?
Describe an achievement you are proud of.
What did you have to do to reach this achievement?
Why is it important for people to set goals in their lives?
Tell me about a book or story that you found memorable.
How did it affect the way you think or feel about something?
Are people reading less than they used to? Why do you think that is?
Describe a city you have visited or would like to visit.
What do you think makes a city a good place to live?
What are the biggest challenges that large cities face today?
Tell me about a type of music or a song that means a lot to you.
How does music affect your mood or daily routine?
Why does music play such an important role in different cultures?
Tell me about a time when you shared a secret with another person.
How did you feel after sharing it?
How important is it to keep other people's secrets?
Describe a gift you have received that was special to you.
Why was this gift so meaningful?
Do you think the price of a gift matters more than the thought behind it?
Tell me about one of the happiest moments of your life.
Why does this moment stand out to you?
Why is it important to remember and celebrate happy moments?
Describe a difficult situation you faced and how you dealt with it.
What did you learn from this experience?
Why do some people handle challenges better than others?
Tell me about a time when you helped someone in need.
How did it feel to help that person?
Why do you think helping others is important in society?
Describe a place that is very special to you.
Why do you like spending time there?
How important is it for people to have a place where they feel comfortable?
Tell me about a meal you really enjoyed.
Who were you with and where did you eat it?
Why do meals often play an important role in bringing people together?
Describe a celebration or festival that is important in your country.
How do people usually celebrate it?
Why is it important to keep traditions and celebrations alive?
